scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n web,realtime -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:realtime"
scripts.dev:full: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n web,realtime,ml,st -c cyan,magenta,yellow,blue "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:st"
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ar/realtime
scripts.start:backend: concurrently -n realtime,ml,st -c magenta,yellow,blue "npm run start -w @ar/realtime" "cd apps/ml-api && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000" "cd apps/style-transfer && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn backend.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
